ModMetaData.name: DMSE 导弹阵地穿梭机与重组远行队修复 / DMSE Missile Base Shuttle & Reform Fix
ModMetaData.author: WhiteGiverMa
ModMetaData.description:
修复 DMSE / FFF 敌方导弹与防空阵地的站点交互问题（适配 2026-11-27 导弹系统迁入 Fortified Features Framework 后的新版结构；上游已修复 validLaunchTarget=false）：
1. 修复清场后因迷雾内敌意阻塞重组远行队：为持有 Fortified.WorldObjectComp_MissileBase 的敌方导弹阵地（DMSE_MissileBase / DMSE_FieldLaunchSite / DMSE_BallisticLaunchSite / DMSE_SeaLaunchSite 等）采用临时营地式迷雾威胁规则（CanReformFoggedEnemies=true）。 2. 修复打空燃料的炮塔永久阻塞重组：仅在导弹阵地地图上，让真正燃料不足一发且无有效 SAM/CIWS（含 CE 弹匣）的炮塔不再永久阻塞。 3. 修复 CompMissileRackStorage 库存导弹无法被远行队/穿梭机直接搜刮：清场安全后，通过真实 ThingOwner.TryDrop 落地进入原版远行队与穿梭机装载流程。 4. 保留启动兜底：若未来或第三方阵地仍误设 validLaunchTarget=false，会将其修正为 true（同时保留 BVR 防空风险确认、拦截与撤退重入冷却）。
不会把仍有电且武装的炮塔当作安全目标，也不会远程清空活跃防空系统。不修改工坊原件，不写自定义存档字段，可安全增删。
Standalone DMSE / FFF missile-site interaction fix (rebased to Fortified Features Framework 1.7 after the 2026-11-27 missile migration; upstream already fixed validLaunchTarget=false): 1. Fixes fogged-enemy reform deadlocks on Fortified.WorldObjectComp_MissileBase sites by enabling CanReformFoggedEnemies=true. 2. Fixes genuinely dry turrets blocking caravan reform on missile-base maps while keeping powered/loaded SAMs and fueled/magazine-loaded CIWS protected. 3. Makes safe CompMissileRackStorage contents genuinely collectible through vanilla ground-loot, caravan, and transporter paths via ThingOwner.TryDrop. 4. Keeps a no-op startup guard in case a missile-base def still sets validLaunchTarget=false, while preserving BVR interception prompts, live air defense, and post-retreat re-entry cooldowns.
No Workshop edits, no custom save fields, safe to add or remove.
